text:
Your HTTP Request node is posting `cleanOutput` as JSON to your local API but receives “Bad request - please check your parameters.”

This needs an experienced human on the [n8n community forum](https://community.n8n.io/) because the available documentation doesn’t establish how this raw-body expression is sent.

**Problem:** HTTP Request v4.4 POST to `http://host.docker.internal:8082/api/assistant/intent`, raw body `={{ $json.cleanOutput }}`, JSON Content-Type/Accept headers; returns “Bad request.”
**Version and setup:** n8n “latest” (exact version unspecified), local Docker on Windows 10; default execution-process setting; database reported as N/A.

Copy appears to work, but you can’t paste nodes within or between workflows, or paste a workflow into your post.

This needs human investigation because the information provided doesn’t establish why pasting fails or whether it’s version-related.

Please open a likely-bug report on [n8n-io/n8n GitHub Issues](https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/issues), including the summary below.

**Problem:** Copy appears to work; paste fails within and across workflows and when sharing the workflow, with no error message. Duplicate is available for a selected node.
**Version and setup:** n8n 2.7.5, self-hosted via Docker on Ubuntu 22.04.5 LTS (Jammy); default database and EXECUTIONS_PROCESS settings.

You want to filter RSS items to files under 5GB, but their sizes mix MiB and GiB.

This needs a human because I can’t verify the If node’s expression evaluation and output routing well enough to give you a reliable answer.

Please share this with an experienced n8n user on the [community forum](https://community.n8n.io/), including your workflow.

Problem: Filter RSS files under 5GB; `nyaa:size` contains MiB/GiB strings, and the shared If node compares it numerically with 5.
Version/setup: n8n 2.7.5 via npm; default database and execution-process settings; OS not provided.

You want to upload the alphabetically first extracted file, but its key isn’t necessarily `file_0`.

This needs a human because I can’t reliably confirm how your workflow’s binary output maps to the HTTP Request upload field.

Please share this with an experienced n8n user on the [community forum](https://community.n8n.io/), including your workflow.

**Problem:** ZIP extraction → filename sorting → upload the first file; HTTP Request currently references `file_0`, which may not identify that file.
**Version and setup:** n8n 1.123.16, npm on Windows Server 2022; default database and EXECUTIONS_PROCESS settings.

Your eight-host ping workflow appears to process only the first host and sends just one Telegram alert.

This needs a human because I can’t verify the item-processing behavior needed to explain the result reliably.

An experienced person on the [n8n community forum](https://community.n8n.io/) is the right contact for reviewing this workflow.

Problem: Eight hosts supplied by a Code node; Execute Command reportedly runs only the first, with one Telegram alert even when all hosts are deliberately invalid.
Version and setup: Reported as “latest”; self-hosted n8n in an LXC container on Linux; EXECUTIONS_PROCESS value not provided.

One bad item is stopping your long-running execution after partial database writes, making retries unsafe.

This needs an experienced human on the n8n community forum because your error-boundary and retry-safety requirements need workflow-specific review.

Problem: Queue-mode executions process thousands of items; a malformed item throws in a Function or DB node, halting execution after partial writes, and retries cause duplicates or inconsistent state. Continue On Fail doesn’t provide enough control.
Version and setup: Version not provided; queue mode with multiple workers, external APIs and a database. Database type, hosting method, OS and EXECUTIONS_PROCESS setting not provided.

Your RSS workflow returns no items despite multiple date comparisons intended to keep the latest 10 days.

This needs a human to review the shared workflow and date-picker error, because they may indicate a Filter node bug.

Please open an issue on [n8n-io/n8n](https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/issues), including your shared workflow and the summary below.

**Problem:** Filtering `pubDate` from `http://krebsonsecurity.com/feed/` returns nothing across multiple date comparisons; selecting tomorrow in the date picker produces a datetime-conversion error.
**Version and setup:** n8n version and hosting not provided; Manual Trigger → RSS Read v1.2 → Filter v2.3, with strict date-time validation.

You’re getting immediate User Prompt validation errors when inserting `message.content`, and the UI cuts off the error text.

This needs a human because the unreadable validation message prevents us from identifying the cause from the information provided.

Since this may be a validation or error-display bug, please open an issue on [n8n-io/n8n](https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/issues) for human review.

**Problem:** AI Agent User Prompt immediately rejects `message.content` via drag-and-drop or expression; error text is unreadable, and previous suggested fixes haven’t helped.
**Version and setup:** Version and hosting type not provided; AI Agent node with Chat Model reported as configured and connected.

You can copy nodes, but pasting nodes or entire workflows fails despite following the copy/paste instructions.

This needs a human to investigate because the documentation has no exact fix for the clipboard failure on your self-hosted setup.

As this may be a bug, please open an issue on [n8n-io/n8n GitHub](https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/issues).

**Problem:** Copy appears to work; paste fails within and across workflows and for entire workflows, with no error message.  
**Version and setup:** n8n 2.7.5, self-hosted via Docker on Ubuntu 22.04.5 LTS; default database and execution settings.

A single bad item stops your execution, while partial database writes make retries produce duplicates or inconsistent state.

This needs human review because error isolation and retry safety in your multi-worker workflow must be assessed before recommending changes.

Please take this to an experienced person on the n8n community forum for review.

**Problem:** Long-running executions processing thousands of items fail on malformed input; earlier database writes remain, and retries cause duplicates or inconsistent state.
**Version and setup:** Version not provided; queue mode with multiple workers, external APIs, and a database. Database type, hosting method, OS, and EXECUTIONS_PROCESS setting not provided.

Your master workflow’s Error Workflow isn’t triggering when a sub-workflow fails during a manual run.

This needs a human to verify the expected behavior in n8n 2.17.8 because the documentation doesn’t explicitly cover this scenario.

For this potential bug, please open an issue on [n8n-io/n8n](https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/issues).

**Problem:** Manually executed master workflow, with “Wait For Sub-Workflow Completion” enabled and an Error Workflow configured, does not trigger that Error Workflow when a sub-workflow fails.
**Version and setup:** n8n 2.17.8; PostgreSQL; Coolify/Docker on Ubuntu; EXECUTIONS_PROCESS setting not provided.

You followed the n8n Google Cloud Run guide exactly but still see “No network connection.”

This needs a human to investigate your deployment and verify the guide’s custom health endpoint configuration against your setup.

Please post on the [n8n community forum](https://community.n8n.io/), where an experienced community member can review this self-hosted deployment.

**Problem:** “No network connection. Workflow changes will be saved once the connection is restored” after following the Cloud Run guide exactly.
**Version and setup:** n8n version not provided; self-hosted on Google Cloud Run in a newly created Google Cloud project.

Your Discord credential test passes, but sending fails with “Invalid URL” across versions despite hours of troubleshooting.

This needs a human to investigate the Discord node’s `sendLegacy` execution path, because the supplied documentation doesn’t cover this failure.

Please open a likely-bug issue on [n8n-io/n8n](https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/issues).

**Problem:** Discord v2 webhook authentication succeeds; sending “Test” fails in `sendLegacy` with `NodeOperationError: Invalid URL` at `parseDiscordError`; workflow and stack trace supplied.
**Version/setup:** Self-hosted Docker Compose via Komodo, Linux, default SQLite; reported versions conflict: 2.64.4 in narrative, 2.26.4 in trace, 2.34.4 in setup; newest stable also affected.

Your AI Agent stops the whole workflow when a tool returns no result, and you want it to continue or skip that tool.

This needs a human to inspect the tool output and execution error, because the documentation doesn’t explain how to handle this case.

Please post on the [n8n community forum](https://community.n8n.io/) so an experienced person can review it.

**Problem:** AI Agent stops when a tool returns no result; desired behavior is to continue or skip the tool.
**Version and setup:** Not provided; n8n version, Cloud/self-hosted setup, and tool details are unknown.

Since updating, Execute Command briefly opens visible cmd/PowerShell windows and steals focus while you work on the server.

This needs human investigation because it may be a regression, and the provided documentation doesn’t cover this behavior.

Please report it as a possible bug on [n8n-io/n8n’s GitHub issue tracker](https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/issues), including the summary below.

**Problem:** After updating to 2.29.7, Execute Command briefly displays cmd/PowerShell windows, taking focus from other applications.
**Version and setup:** n8n 2.29.7 via npm; Windows Server 2019 Datacenter 1809; SQLite; `EXECUTIONS_PROCESS=main`.

Your PostgreSQL workflow can leave a customer marked “processing” when a later log insert fails.

This needs human review of transaction boundaries and failure handling because incorrect rollback or retry guidance could leave data inconsistent or overwrite valid changes.

Please bring this to an experienced person on the [n8n community forum](https://community.n8n.io/).

Problem: Earlier PostgreSQL operations succeed but later ones fail; you need guidance on transactions, rollback, and idempotency without leaving partial updates.
Version and setup: Not provided—n8n version, internal database, EXECUTIONS_PROCESS setting, hosting method, and operating system are unknown.

You want to upload the alphabetically first file extracted from a ZIP, but its key isn’t necessarily `file_0`.

This needs a human because the available documentation doesn’t establish how to handle binary-file selection in your workflow.

Please share this with an experienced n8n user on the [community forum](https://community.n8n.io/), including your workflow.

Problem: ZIP extraction → filename sorting → upload first file; HTTP Request currently references `file_0`, which may not identify the selected file.
Version and setup: n8n 1.123.16, installed via npm on Windows Server 2022; default database and EXECUTIONS_PROCESS settings.

You’re on n8n Cloud Starter and seeing workflows run for over an hour despite documentation mentioning plan-specific timeout limits.

This needs a human from n8n Cloud support for your plan to confirm the current Starter timeout and explain why your executions exceed an hour, since the documentation doesn’t specify the limit.

**Problem:** Confirm the current Cloud Starter execution timeout and clarify why workflows run for >1 hour; older information cited 5 minutes, while current docs omit the plan’s limit.
**Version and setup:** n8n version not provided; n8n Cloud, Starter plan.

Your Ollama Cloud credential test succeeds, but the model dropdown shows “No results.”

This needs a human to investigate the node’s Ollama Cloud compatibility and model-list request, because a successful credential test doesn’t explain the empty list.

Please open an issue on [n8n-io/n8n](https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/issues) as a potential bug.

**Problem:** Ollama Cloud connection test succeeds, but model discovery returns “No results.”
**Version and setup:** n8n version and hosting type not provided; Ollama Cloud API key configured in an n8n credential with base URL `https://ollama.com`.

Your Google Sheets error keeps returning despite credential reconnection, VPS restarts, and node-version changes.

This needs human investigation because the intermittent error and malformed stack trace have no exact documented fix.

As a likely bug, please report it in [n8n-io/n8n’s GitHub issues](https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/issues).

Problem: Intermittent `dummy.stack.replace is not a function` across Google Sheets operations in manual and workflow executions; stack trace contains only `{}` objects, and previous attempts haven’t resolved it permanently.
Version/setup: n8n 2.15.0, self-hosted on Hostinger VPS; `n8n-nodes-base.googleSheets` versions 4.2 and 4.7 tested; Google OAuth2.

Your webhooks can arrive out of order, risking an older order status overwriting a newer one.

This needs a human to validate the source’s event-ordering guarantees and assess concurrency-safe PostgreSQL updates without assuming timestamps or versions are reliable.

Please post on the [n8n community forum](https://community.n8n.io/) so an experienced person can review this with you.

Problem: Out-of-order order events; current PostgreSQL update unconditionally sets status and `updated_at = NOW()`. Seeking safe timestamp, sequence, or version handling.
Version and setup: n8n version, hosting method, OS, n8n database, and execution-process setting not provided; order data is in PostgreSQL.

You’re looking for free hosting to test your working n8n deployment after your Render and Railway trials ended.

This needs an experienced human on the [n8n community forum](https://community.n8n.io/), because current free-tier availability and potential charges need verification before recommending a provider.

**Problem:** Needs a free or generous free-plan hosting alternative to Render/Railway for deployment testing; the Messenger AI workflow runs correctly locally.
**Version and setup:** n8n 1.79.3 in local Docker Desktop; database, EXECUTIONS_PROCESS setting, and operating system not provided.

You’re researching how agencies onboard clients and hand over completed n8n workflows.

This needs a human because you’re looking for firsthand agency experience, not technical troubleshooting.

An experienced agency owner or n8n developer on the [n8n community forum](https://community.n8n.io/) is the right person to weigh in.

Problem: Research into client onboarding, account/API/credential connections, handoff bottlenecks, repetitive delivery tasks, and the number of client workflows managed simultaneously.
Version and setup: Not provided; this is a research question rather than a reported technical issue.

Your workflow reaches the Execute Sub-workflow node, but it rejects one input even though the value looks correct in the previous node.

This needs a human to inspect the exact error, input value, and expected sub-workflow input type before determining what’s wrong.

An experienced person on the [n8n community forum](https://community.n8n.io/) is the right person to review this.

**Problem:** One input is rejected at the sub-workflow boundary; exact error, value, and expected type weren’t provided.
**Version and setup:** n8n version and Cloud/self-hosted setup weren’t provided.

You’re trying to set a workflow description through the n8n API, but adding a description field under `meta` didn’t work.

This needs a human to verify whether workflow descriptions are API-writable and which field, if any, is supported, because the documentation doesn’t clarify this.

Please post this question on the [n8n community forum](https://community.n8n.io/) for an experienced person to review.

**Problem:** Set a workflow description via the API; adding a description field under `meta` did not work.
**Version and setup:** Not provided; n8n version, database, execution setting, deployment method, and operating system are unknown.

Your API-created Code node shows both JavaScript and Python editors when you select Python or `pythonNative`.

This needs human investigation because the duplicate editor rendering may be a bug, and the documentation doesn’t explain this behavior.

Please open an issue on [n8n-io/n8n](https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/issues) so the maintainers can investigate.

**Problem:** API-created Code nodes using Python/`pythonNative` display a JavaScript editor containing Python code plus a Python editor; `javaScript` renders correctly.
**Version and setup:** n8n 2.10.4, running via Docker on Windows; workflows created through the API using TypeScript.

Your tasks have timed out after 60 seconds for a week, even with a basic node and workflow optimization.

This needs a human to investigate runner availability and instance logs before recommending whether to restart.

If you’re on n8n Cloud, contact n8n support through your plan’s support channel; otherwise, an experienced person on the [community forum](https://community.n8n.io/) is the right next contact.

Problem: “Task request timed out after 60 seconds” for one week; basic-node testing and workflow optimization haven’t helped; asking whether to restart.
Version and setup: Not provided—n8n version, database, EXECUTIONS_PROCESS setting, hosting method, and operating system are unknown.

Your memory key works until the AI agent calls a tool, then becomes undefined in both Postgres and Simple Memory.

This needs human investigation because the tool-dependent failure isn’t covered by the manual session ID documentation and may be a bug.

The right handoff is a [GitHub issue on n8n-io/n8n](https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/issues).

**Problem:** Tool calls cause “Key parameter is empty” in both memory nodes; non-tool messages work. Timestamp and webhook sender ID keys were both tried.
**Version and setup:** n8n 2.22.5, running via npm; Instagram chatbot triggered by a webhook, not Chat Trigger. Database and OS unspecified.

Your two Wait branches aren’t running simultaneously: the 20-second Wait appears to start after the 10-second Wait finishes.

This needs a human to confirm your workflow’s execution settings and advise on a supported approach to concurrency.

Please post on the **n8n community forum**, where an experienced person can review the workflow you shared.

**Problem:** Manual trigger connects to 10-second and 20-second Wait branches; you observe sequential waiting, want simultaneous execution, and see no error.
**Version and setup:** Not provided: n8n version, database, EXECUTIONS_PROCESS setting, hosting method, and operating system.

Your Supabase retrieval still returns PGRST202 after you applied the SQL solution from an earlier topic.

This needs a human to inspect the matching function’s signature alongside your Supabase node configuration.

Please share this with an experienced person on the [n8n community forum](https://community.n8n.io/), including your workflow and the summary below.

**Problem:** AI Agent’s Supabase tool cannot find `public.match_documents(filter, match_count, query_embedding)` in the schema cache; previous SQL solution did not help. Uses `knowledge_chunks`, retrieve-as-tool mode, topK 2.
**Version and setup:** n8n 2.35.7; browser access on Windows 11 Home; hosting method and database unspecified.

You want to keep real Asana runs while preventing heartbeat-only executions from filling execution history.

This needs a human to assess a supported approach, because the available documentation covers disabling all successful execution storage or pruning—not heartbeat-only suppression.

Please bring this to an experienced n8n contributor on the [community forum](https://community.n8n.io/).

**Problem:** ~206 Asana webhooks generate thousands of successful heartbeat executions daily; `events.length > 0` filters them out, but records remain in Postgres. Real runs must be retained.
**Version/setup:** n8n 2.0.0; Docker, self-hosted on an Azure Ubuntu VM; Postgres 16; default main execution process; no execution pruning configured.

You’re seeing the Send Email (SMTP) node hang or fail silently on n8n Cloud and need clarity on outbound SMTP restrictions.

This needs a human at n8n support for your Cloud plan, because the SMTP configuration documentation doesn’t establish Cloud infrastructure restrictions, plan differences, or supported alternatives.

Please contact n8n Cloud support through the support channel available for your plan.

Problem: SMTP node hangs/fails silently; confirm whether ports 465/587 are blocked, restricted, or rate-limited, whether this varies by plan, and what workaround is supported.
Version and setup: n8n Cloud, Send Email (SMTP) node; n8n version, plan tier, and SMTP provider not provided.

You’re preparing to delete a departing user who owns most workflows and credentials, and need clarity on transfers, tags, and credential sharing.

This needs a human review because incorrect guidance about ownership and access could break workflows or cause data loss.

Please bring this to an experienced person on the n8n community forum.

**Problem:** Confirm deletion-time workflow/credential transfers, tag retention, credential-sharing impact, and any manual checks; server/database snapshots are planned and raw JSON exports are saved.
**Version/setup:** n8n 2.26.8; PostgreSQL; Docker on Linux; EXECUTIONS_PROCESS not specified.

Your Gemini, GPT, and Perplexity branches run one after another, making the total wait up to 20 seconds.

This needs a human to assess a supported parallel-execution approach, because the documentation describes sequential branch execution but doesn’t explicitly address running these LLM branches concurrently.

Please take this to an experienced community member on the [n8n community forum](https://community.n8n.io/).

Problem: Run multiple LLM branches concurrently so total execution time approaches the slowest model’s time rather than their sum.
Version and setup: n8n version and hosting type not provided; Gemini, GPT, and Perplexity branches feeding a Merge node.

Your local lint passes, but the package scanner rejects compiled JavaScript in `dist` with a TypeScript filename requirement.

This needs human investigation because the apparent scanner/rule mismatch may be a bug, and the documentation doesn’t establish an exact fix.

Please open a [GitHub issue on n8n-io/n8n](https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/issues) for review.

Problem: Creator Portal scanning of `@ambriel-io/n8n-nodes-ambriel` flags `dist/credentials/AmbrielApi.credentials.js` with `cred-filename-against-convention`, requesting `AmbrielApi.credentials.ts`; local lint passes.
Version and setup: n8n 2.31.4, npm on macOS, default SQLite, `EXECUTIONS_PROCESS=own`; scanner version not provided.

Your test webhook returns HTTP 500 before execution, even while the workflow is listening.

This needs human investigation because the supplied excerpts contain no documented fix for this error, and confirming a likely bug requires review.

Please report this likely bug in [n8n-io/n8n’s GitHub issues](https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/issues), including the stack trace you shared.

**Problem:** Twilio POST to `/webhook-test/whatsapp-webhook` returns 500 before execution; `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'name')` in `getChildNodes` / `checkResponseModeConfiguration`, despite listening mode.
**Version and setup:** n8n Cloud 2.6.3; POST webhook path `whatsapp-webhook`; manual test endpoint; Twilio error 11200.

Your Ollama AI nodes fail through Squid, while curl, HTTP Request, and credential checks succeed.

This needs human investigation because the documented proxy limitations don’t explain this discrepancy or provide an exact fix.

For this likely bug, the right destination is a [GitHub issue on n8n-io/n8n](https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/issues), where maintainers can review your supplied workflow and setup.

**Problem:** AI Agent/Ollama chat fails with “fetch failed”; curl `/api/tags` and `/api/chat`, HTTP Request, and credential checks succeed.
**Version/setup:** n8n 2.20.6, self-hosted Docker, Squid proxy, SQLite, default execution setting, Ubuntu 26.4; remote GPU-hosted Ollama container (reported latest), model `qwen3.5:9b`.

n8n reports a successful connection with your Open WebUI API key, but `/api/tags` returns HTML and no models appear.

This needs human investigation because proxy routing and n8n’s credential-test validation need to be checked together.

The reported success makes this a likely bug; the right handoff is your existing [n8n GitHub issue #36355](https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/issues/36355).

**Problem:** Authenticated Open WebUI connection passes n8n’s test; `/api/tags` returns HTTP 200 with HTML, and models don’t populate.
**Version/setup:** n8n 2.30.7, self-hosted Docker on Hostinger via Caddy → local Docker Open WebUI via Caddy → local Ollama; API key configured.

You’re looking for a straightforward way to update OVH’s preinstalled n8n and manage its environment variables.

This needs a human because OVH’s preinstalled setup isn’t covered in our documentation, and its installation method and configuration need verification before safe changes can be recommended.

An experienced self-hosting user on the [n8n community forum](https://community.n8n.io/) is the right person to help.

**Problem:** Wants safe update and environment-variable management options without unnecessary complexity.  
**Version and setup:** n8n 1.x.x (exact version unknown), preinstalled on a fresh OVH VPS; comfortable with SSH and already self-hosts on Render via Docker.

Your n8n is fast locally and over Tailscale, but pages load slowly or hang through Cloudflare Tunnel.

This needs a human because the documentation doesn’t provide an exact fix, and investigating your tunnel routing and Docker networking requires setup-specific expertise.

Please post on the [n8n community forum](https://community.n8n.io/) so someone experienced with self-hosted networking can investigate.

**Problem:** Cloudflare-tunneled access is slow or hangs; local and Tailscale access work normally.
**Version and setup:** n8n version not provided; Docker on CasaOS, Cloudflare Tunnel for Gmail webhooks, based in Southeast Asia.

Your Mailjet sandbox setting is being overwritten during environment sync, putting production email delivery at risk.

This needs human investigation because it appears to conflict with the documented credential-sync behavior and may be a bug.

Please report it to the n8n maintainers via a [GitHub issue on n8n-io/n8n](https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/issues).

Problem: Source-control push/pull overwrites Mailjet’s sandbox setting across lab, test, and prod; sandbox should remain enabled in lab/test and disabled in prod, while credential values reportedly aren’t synced.
Version/setup: n8n 2.9.3 on all three deployments; separate GitHub branches linked through environments; PostgreSQL; queue execution; Docker on Azure Container Apps.

You’re passing the documented cursor, but `nextCursor` repeats even though the returned workflow data changes.

This needs human investigation because the pagination behavior may be an API bug and can’t be confirmed from the example alone.

Please report this likely bug in [n8n-io/n8n GitHub issues](https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/issues).

**Problem:** `GET /api/v1/workflows?limit=10&cursor=eyJsaW1pdCI6MTAsIm9mZnNldCI6MTB9` returns the same `nextCursor` while workflow data changes.
**Version and setup:** n8n Cloud 1.123.14; reported database: SQLite; `EXECUTIONS_PROCESS=own`.

Your queue-mode workers sometimes encounter slow executions and blocked PostgreSQL queries when webhook bursts trigger concurrent updates to the same records.

This needs human review of transaction boundaries, workflow concurrency, and PostgreSQL lock diagnostics because locking or retry changes could compromise data integrity or disrupt production.

Please bring this to an experienced person on the n8n community forum for a workload-specific review.

Problem: Concurrent updates to shared records during webhook bursts cause occasional slowdowns and blocked queries; seeking consistency-preserving concurrency guidance.
Version and setup: n8n version not provided; queue mode with multiple workers and PostgreSQL; hosting method, OS, and EXECUTIONS_PROCESS setting not provided.

Your sync is missing and duplicating records, with stale cursors on resume and inconsistent results during overlapping runs.

This needs human review of the workflow, cursor persistence, retry behavior, and overlapping executions before recommending changes that could cause further data loss.

Please bring this to an experienced person on the [n8n community forum](https://community.n8n.io/).

Problem: Five-minute Cron sync using cursor pagination and database upserts; API has unordered/duplicate records, timeouts and 429s; missing/duplicate records, stale cursors and retry/overlap inconsistencies reported.  
Version and setup: n8n version, database, EXECUTIONS_PROCESS setting, hosting method and OS not provided; workflow and execution output not included.

Your n8n Cloud workspace has been inaccessible with 503 errors for over an hour despite a manual restart, with a demo approaching.

This needs a human at n8n Cloud support for your plan because investigating and recovering your specific instance requires access unavailable here.

Your existing support request is the right route; it needs human escalation for the inaccessible Cloud instance, not workflow-optimization advice.

Problem: Persistent 503 after the first workflow run (Gmail PDF attachments + three Claude agents); suspected memory-limit crash, manual restart unsuccessful, instance reports online.
Version and setup: Latest n8n; n8n Cloud; default database and Cloud-managed EXECUTIONS_PROCESS; macOS.

Your RSS date filter returns nothing—even for opposite comparisons—and the date picker reports a conversion error.

This needs a human to inspect the RSS `pubDate` values and reproduce the Filter behavior, since the documentation doesn’t clearly explain these symptoms.

Please open a suspected-bug issue on [n8n-io/n8n](https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/issues), including your shared workflow and the details below.

**Problem:** Filtering `krebsonsecurity.com/feed/` to the last 10 days produces no output across complementary date comparisons; selecting tomorrow in the date picker causes a datetime conversion error.  
**Version/setup:** n8n version and hosting not provided; Manual Trigger → RSS Read v1.2 → Filter v2.3, comparing `$json.pubDate` with strict date validation.

Your workflow won’t publish despite passing mock-data tests and showing no visible node errors.

This needs a human because the actual error text and full workflow are needed to investigate publishing and trigger activation on your Cloud instance.

Please contact **n8n Cloud support through the support channel available for your plan**; they’ll need the error text and complete workflow, since the shared export is truncated.

**Problem:** Publishing fails with an uninformative error; mock-data tests pass, no visible node errors; error text and full workflow still needed.
**Version and setup:** n8n 2.9.4, n8n Cloud; workflow includes a Zendesk Trigger and OpenAI/LangChain nodes.

You want to know whether you can sign up with a personal email because you don’t have a company email.

This needs a human to confirm, because the documentation doesn’t establish whether personal email addresses are accepted at signup.

Please contact n8n Cloud support through the support channel available for your plan.

Problem: Signup asks for a company email; you only have a personal email and want to know whether it’s accepted for normal use.
Version and setup: Version not provided; signing up for n8n, with the hosting setup not confirmed.

You’re blocked in n8n102 Section 2 by the HTTPS/HTTP mismatch, with Section 1’s SendToPriorityQueue issue still unresolved.

This needs a human because both the reported course/testing-page mismatch and the earlier issue require investigation beyond the supplied workflow.

For this suspected bug, please open an issue on [n8n-io/n8n](https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/issues), including the workflow you shared and both blockers.

**Problem:** Section 2’s testing page reportedly requires HTTPS while the tutorial uses HTTP; Section 1’s SendToPriorityQueue issue remains unresolved.
**Version/setup:** n8n version and hosting setup not provided; supplied workflow uses Webhook v2.1 with POST, header authentication, and Respond to Webhook nodes.

Your Scheduling Agent ignores valid availability JSON despite successful tool execution and prompt changes.
